title: The Ghost in the Genome: High-Dimensional Constraints and the Bi-state Dynamics of Homologous Gene Groups

creators.name: Meng, Xianwen
creators.affiliation: School of Information Engineering, Yulin University, Yulin, Shaanxi, 719000, China

description:
Conceptual synthesis and hypothesis framework; version 2.0. This manuscript develops homologous gene groups (HGGs) as candidate evolutionary entities whose continuity can be investigated separately from member turnover, and proposes stable/transition dynamics as a testable hypothesis. Multi-layer constraints are a causal extension; protein language models are an optional measurement extension.

Candidate construction is separated from independent evaluation against hierarchical orthologous groups and other established units. The manuscript develops competing explanations, controls and module-specific rejection criteria. A placental-mammal beta-globin example illustrates the proposed tests. Genome-wide, multispecies validation remains outstanding.

This expanded version retains the original title and author of version 1.0, first released on 13 February 2026 (10.5281/zenodo.18626931).
